lede: Specialist repair and rebuild of BMW's N63 and S63 twin-turbo V8 engines.

sections.heading: What Does BMW Hot-Vee V8 Engine Repair Involve?

blocks.html: The N63 and S63 engines feature a "hot-vee" design where the twin turbochargers are mounted between the cylinder banks. This creates high under-bonnet temperatures and makes access significantly more difficult than conventional V8 layouts. Our repair process is designed to address the specific challenges of this engine family.

items: **Rod bearing replacement** – full engine strip-down to access and replace all connecting rod bearings, a preventive measure on higher-mileage examples
**Turbocharger servicing** – removal and inspection of hot-vee mounted turbos, including oil and coolant line checks
**Valve stem seal replacement** – addressing oil consumption issues, performed with precision and, where possible, without removing the cylinder head
**Cooling system overhaul** – full inspection and bleeding of the multiple cooling circuits, including turbocharger cooling lines and radiator cleaning
**Full reassembly with torque-critical fasteners** – hundreds of bolts torqued to BMW's exact specifications using digital torque wrenches and specialist tools

steps.title: Inspection & Assessment
steps.body: We strip the engine to inspect all components. This gives us a clear picture of what's needed before any work begins.

items.a: A hot-vee engine has the turbochargers mounted between the cylinder banks in the "V" of the engine. This design allows for shorter exhaust paths and improved packaging, but creates high temperatures and makes access to the turbos and related components more difficult.

items.q: How long does a hot-vee V8 repair take?
items.a: A full strip-down and rebuild typically takes 3–5 days, depending on the extent of the work required and parts availability. We provide a clear timeline during the inspection and quote process.

items.q: Is a hot-vee V8 repair more expensive than a standard V8?
items.a: Yes, due to the additional labour and complexity involved. Accessing the turbos and performing repairs in the hot-vee area takes significantly longer than a conventional V8 layout. Our fixed-price quotes account for this.

items.q: Do you offer a warranty on hot-vee V8 repairs?
items.a: Yes, all our engine repairs include a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty. The warranty covers parts and labour for the work we have completed.
